volume_step.reason: TX and waveform do not confirm a volume change; hold and repeat are not exposed

source.reason: TX and waveform do not confirm receiver execution; TAPE2 is a MONITOR, not a source selection

cd_track_select.reason: Track N is floor(N/10) ROOT 0xDA then one digit frame; 1-39 is an operational limit; TX and waveform do not confirm the track

cd_transport.reason: TX and waveform do not confirm a track change; blocked actions are not exposed by this Gateway

cd_playback.reason: STOP 0xA1, TIME_DISPLAY 0xEA, REPEAT 0xCC and DISC_SKIP 0x8A are physically observed; PLAY/PAUSE 0xBC is a historical mapping not yet physically verified; TX and waveform do not confirm a changer action

volume_hold.reason: Held VOL+/VOL- on a service connection; a short press stays one VOLUME_STEP

power.reason: ROOT 0x52 ON and ROOT 0x62 OFF are physically verified; TX does not confirm execution and no power state is read back

tape2_monitor.reason: CONTEXT 0x48 is a historical MONITOR toggle, not yet physically validated; the indicator shows only observed receiver reports

cd_seek.reason: Held KEY DOWN with a service lease and maximum; TX and waveform do not confirm seeking
